title: Exact cycles → shared-state split-flow
economic_condition: Terminal settlement atoms minus repayment and non-embedded costs > 0 for an independently evaluated amount; shared state consumes liquidity once.
first_experiment: Сначала 2 synthetic Solana CPMM routes с общим pool и 8 точными суммами: single vs disjoint split vs sequential shared-state split. Затем один квалифицированный новый AMM model, не все PX сразу.
kill_criteria: Naive split gain исчезает при общем state; amount semantics не доказаны; ресурс или fee не учтён.
product_hypothesis: Capacity & Route Evidence API; позже reusable exact adapters.
compatibility_constraints: Внутри circular route повтор venue запрещён как прежде. Общий venue между разными paths требует state transition.
Pool address, singleton address и liquidity alias — разные identities.

title: Vault conversion ↔ DEX ↔ credit
economic_condition: Immediate conversion proceeds after all costs cover exact obligations; projected interest savings remain a separate horizon-dependent metric.
first_experiment: Один immediate redeem и один delayed claim, 2 liquidity states и 2 health/cap states. Сравнить direct swap, redeem+swap, repay/unlock; проверить terminal position одинакового качества.
kill_criteria: Queue requires waiting; caps unknown; proceeds in another asset; final health fails; no independent model parity.
product_hypothesis: Treasury/collateral planning API с объяснимыми liquidity deadlines.
compatibility_constraints: Generic ERC-4626 surface не доказывает limits конкретного vault.
Flash callbacks не разрешают пропускать checks других protocols.

title: Intents → netting → residual exact routing
economic_condition: Same filled user obligations; each user meets limit and comparator; customer cost reduction and solver fee accounted separately.
first_experiment: 10 synthetic intents, 3 assets, 4 venues: independent feasible fills vs netting+residual routes. Include exclusivity, cancellation, partial fills and delayed order observation.
kill_criteria: Aggregate surplus hides user loss; unavailable RFQ flow assumed; feed only recent orders treated as full market.
product_hypothesis: Clearing quote/evidence API для wallets, treasury и intent builders.
compatibility_constraints: Netting снижает промежуточную потребность в капитале, но не создаёт право распоряжаться чужими balances.
Generic intent owner wrappers требуют реализации у существующего owner.

title: aToken / shared wallet liquidity → funding-aware mechanism lab
classification: leveraged LP research, not guaranteed arbitrage
economic_condition: LP fee income + supply income - borrowing cost - losses - operations; compare equal initial equity and equal risk, no TVL multiplication as profit.
first_experiment: Synthetic balance100 и 2 virtual strategies по80: adversarial order sequence, collateral shocks, allowance change, flow drought. Compare unlevered vs leveraged under same customer flow.
kill_criteria: Benefit survives only subsidized or frozen flow; cumulative obligations exceed real assets; missing taker access.
product_hypothesis: Capital-efficiency diagnostics и model qualification service.
compatibility_constraints: Read cash growth-index limitation in owner review before any yield fixture reuse.
Успешный post-state не исправляет недопустимый intermediate state.

title: Cross-domain intents → inventory netting → settlement evidence
economic_condition: Delivered-flow revenue minus gas, funding duration, rebalancing, failures and service cost; capacity constrained by capital until reimbursement.
first_experiment: 2 domains, 2 assets, 10 intents; compare one-way prefunding and two-way matched inventory. Stress proof delay, origin reorg, fill timeout, refund and duplicate events.
kill_criteria: Claimed turnover uses fill time instead of settlement time; trapped inventory exceeds budget; unknown finality assumptions.
product_hypothesis: Inventory/rebalancing planner и settlement reconciliation API.
compatibility_constraints: Proof status, fill status and spendable balance are separate state machines.

title: Funding claims ↔ perps / new builder markets
economic_condition: Matched cashflows after entry/exit fees, funding, basis, margin and failure losses; fixed quoted spread alone is insufficient.
first_experiment: 1 underlying, 2 perps, 2 rate claims; compare perfect synthetic hedge with mismatch in index, maturity, session and one failed fill. Baseline equal capital and duration.
kill_criteria: Cannot prove payoff match; position liquidates in stress; no hedge during trading halt; credit/issuer risk ignored.
product_hypothesis: Rate-hedge analytics и multi-venue exposure monitor.
compatibility_constraints: No flash funding for held maturity exposure.
Offchain/CEX and onchain legs remain non-atomic even behind one UI.

title: Orderbooks / conditional claims → exact residual and parity checks
economic_condition: Parity only for matching conditions, collateral and exercisable merge rights; subtract lot dust and all fees.
first_experiment: Synthetic 2-outcome complete set and 2 books: full set, wrong condition, partial acquisition, expired unclosed market, shared BalanceManager conflict.
kill_criteria: Inactive deployment, stale oracle, incomplete book or missing subscription proof; separate outcomes conflated.
product_hypothesis: Market integrity / depth / completeness evidence API.
compatibility_constraints: Sui adapters are future independent qualification, not reuse of Solana strategy live switch.
Prediction probabilities and directional bets are not risk-free circular opportunities.

title: Low-latency state → dependency invalidation → bounded search
economic_condition: Same admissible opportunities with lower end-to-end delay/CPU/data cost; correctness precedes microbench speed.
first_experiment: Replay identical events through full recompute and dirty-subgraph path at 1x/10x/100x input load; record arrival-to-evidence p50/p95/p99, queue, misses, drops and backfill cost.
kill_criteria: Only latency median improves while p99/stale errors worsen; true opportunities silently lost; access cost dominates.
product_hypothesis: Market-state engine and shared evidence infrastructure.
compatibility_constraints: Shortlist cutoff is explicit budget truncation unless a sound bound proves pruning.
Preconfirmed state is a separate generation and commitment class.

title: Evidence providers → exact verifier → API procurement
economic_condition: Buyer value - source, compute, verification, retry, delivery and support costs; recurring unsubsidized demand required.
first_experiment: Local verifier and 3 synthetic providers quote one identical CPMM task. Add wrong state, stale result, slow cheap result, shared upstream and duplicate receipt. Compare local-only baseline.
kill_criteria: Verification cost exceeds saved compute; no buyer demand; reuse violates rights; paid receipt accepted as proof.
product_hypothesis: Market Evidence API first; provider marketplace only after repeat demand and service economics.
compatibility_constraints: x402 is an optional future billing adapter, not the verifier.
Current INST-01 sum-int-v1 benchmark is not a ready arbitrary financial service market.
